name: live_medium
description: Teens. Explicit (exposed) classes at 0.45 plus covered intimate classes at a stricter 0.60; mask the padded BODY-PART boxes (unioned per figure), not the whole picture, so sex-ed / health pages stay readable. UNSURE gets a second look before anything is masked; still UNSURE after it masks the parts. Pre-frost only on a heavy page (adaptive).

notes.score_on: 0.45 for the EXPOSED classes. Not calibrated on real screens: the only real-screen numbers we have are the user's live test (26 Oct), where NudeNet 320n scored FEMALE_BREAST_COVERED 0.72-0.84 and FEMALE_GENITALIA_COVERED 0.64 on content that should have been masked. Exposed-class scores on screen-sized thumbnails are unmeasured; recalibrate privately.
notes.part_pad_frac: 12% of each part box on every side, then parts that touch / overlap are unioned (cluster_nsfw) per figure and clipped to the picture.
notes.unsure_action: Wait for the second look (token bucket, ~4/s) instead of masking on a weak first pass.
notes.clipped_edge_band: A body part cut by the frame / pane edge is too partial for the detector. Slivers too thin to classify are covered, and a picture that already showed an explicit hit also gets a band (0.35 x its width) along the cut edge until it is fully on screen. Pictures seen whole keep their part boxes while they scroll out.
notes.classes: Covered intimate classes (lingerie / see-through / swimwear crotch, breast, buttocks, anus) count too, at a stricter 0.60 (class_score_on); their UNSURE band is 0.45-0.60 (class_score_unsure) so ordinary swimwear around 0.3-0.45 is left alone. FACE_* / FEET_* / ARMPITS_* / BELLY_* and MALE_BREAST_EXPOSED are not counted in medium. Names must match NudeNet's labels exactly (vision_core.nudenet_labels.NUDENET_LABELS); unknown names are dropped.
notes.prefrost: adaptive: no pre-frost on normal pages (it looks bad). Only once a window has had >= heavy_masks active masks within the last heavy_window_s seconds (an NSFW site / heavy page) are new, not-yet-checked pictures pre-frosted until classified.
